title: Testimony, circa 2 November 1831
source_note: Testimony, [Hiram Township, OH, ca. 2 Nov. 1831]; signed by Sidney Rigdon, Orson Hyde, William E. McLellin, Luke Johnson, and Lyman Johnson. Featured version, titled “73 Revelation,” copied with five signatures [between 3 Nov. and ca. 11 Nov. 1831] in Revelation Book 1, p. 121, with additional signatures of Reynolds Cahoon, John Corrill, Parley P. Pratt, Harvey Whitlock, Lyman Wight, John Murdock, Calvin Beebe, Zebedee Coltrin, Joshua Fairchild, Peter Dustin, Newel Knight, Levi Hancock, and Thomas B. Marsh added [between mid-Nov. 1831 and ca. Jan. 1832]; handwriting of John Whitmer; CHL. Includes redactions. For more complete source information, see the source note for Revelation Book 1.
